name: John Fetterman
stance: Opposes pausing AI development or AI data center construction, arguing that it would hand the lead on AI to China.

statements.text: Called the proposed moratorium on AI data center construction from Sen. Sanders and Rep. Ocasio-Cortez "China First," saying guardrails can be put in place without handing the win on AI to China.
Responded to Sen. Sanders's call for AI companies to pause AI development by saying America must lead in the development of AI or live under China's rules.
